name: Tuna or Salmon Salad Cracker Stacks
whyItWorks: Canned fish is pre-cooked to complete softness and loaded with anti-inflammatory omega-3s.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mash drained canned tuna or pink salmon smooth with mayo and a pinch of garlic powder (skip celery or pickle relish chunks). Spoon onto Ritz crackers or Saltines.
